msgs.text: I'll fix the dead docstring links in the GQ2 sources. Let me start by loading the Lean skill, checking my project memory, and surveying all `.html` links in the docstrings.
The pinned checkout is at commit 91e1918, two commits behind master. Current sources have no `html` at all in GQ2. Let me grep the pinned checkout itself and search all branches' history.
Let me read the key function around line 41 and the link-extension logic.
All regions read. Before editing, one batched sanity check that the named declarations actually live in the mapped successor files:
Second batch — the remaining edits in the three files that had two stale paths each:

All dead docstring links are fixed at the source and committed as `b11fbf6` on this session's branch (`claude/quizzical-bell-57c1a9`, not pushed) — 31 occurrences across 21 files, with a verification pass showing zero remaining dead targets.

One correction to the premise, which explains why the suggested greps would have come up empty: the `.lean` sources never contained literal `.html` markdown links. What's actually happening is that doc-gen4's `nameToLink?` ([DocString.lean:41](../../../../gq2-paper/docbuild/.lake/packages/doc-gen4/DocGen4/Output/DocString.lean) in the docbuild checkout) auto-links **any backticked token that contains `/` and ends in `.lean`** to `<doc-root>/<path>.html`, with no existence check. So the working Orientation link came from `` `GQ2/Foundations/Axioms.lean` ``, and the dead ones came from:

1. **Bare `` `Foundations/Axioms.lean` `` (12 occurrences, 7 files)** — missing the `GQ2/` root, rendering as the dead `../Foundations/Axioms.html` hrefs your band-aid script repairs. All now prefixed `GQ2/` (files: KummerSurjectivity, KummerKrullBridge, HilbertSymbolDyadic, HilbertSymbolDyadicClose, HilbertSymbolSufficiency, DyadicPresentation — 11 render in docs, 1 is a line comment fixed for consistency).
2. **Pre-rename flat module paths (19 occurrences, 15 files)** — exactly your class-2 list. Commit `c6a2293` moved these into subdirectories, so every link had a real successor and none needed the plain-text fallback: `BlockDescent → Block/Descent`, `BlockEnrichment → Block/Enrichment`, `GaussZFinal → GaussZ/Final`, `PhaseObstruction → Phase140/Obstruction`, `RStageLocal → RStage/Local`, `ShapiroLedger → Shapiro/Ledger`, etc. I confirmed each mapping both by the rename commit's file pairing and by checking the referenced declaration (`blockStageR136`, `lemma_6_15_free_aux`, `iotaB`, …) actually lives in the successor file.

**Verification** (in lieu of a doc rebuild — the fresh worktree has no build cache): a token-level scan replicating doc-gen4's exact rule over all code spans and plain/`lean` fenced blocks finds 305 linkifiable `.lean` paths, all resolving to existing files; no relative markdown `](...)` links exist anywhere in the docstrings. The one `Mathlib/.../Action/Hom.lean` deep reference in TateDuality.lean is valid in the pinned mathlib and live on mathlib4_docs, so it was left alone. The diff is a pure 31-insertion/31-deletion substitution — docstring text only, no delimiters or code touched, so there's no build risk; CI will confirm on push.

Minor notes: two edited lines now sit at 101/104 chars (these files already carry many 100+ docstring lines, so I didn't reflow paragraphs for it); I spotted an unrelated truncated sentence in the `kummerClassK_surjective'` docstring ([KummerSurjectivity.lean:277](GQ2/KummerSurjectivity.lean:277), "…Consumed by `GQ2/Foundations/Axioms.lean` at the") and flagged it as a background task chip rather than guessing the intended ending. As you said, `gq2-paper` picks this up on the next pin bump of `formalizations/gq2-claude` — the current pin (`91e1918`) is now three commits behind this branch.
